# Lying on a Sofa in a Dream — Meaning

### Traditional Dream Interpretation

According to the traditional Armenian dream dictionary, **lying on a sofa in a dream signifies hard work or harm caused by a woman**. These are two alternative meanings of the same dream.

### What Does It Mean to Dream About Lying on a Sofa?

A sofa usually suggests rest and comfort. In this old interpretation, however, such a peaceful scene takes on a surprisingly cautionary meaning. Behind the image of relaxation may lie responsibilities or relationships that call for closer attention.

### Hard Work

The first meaning is demanding work. Perhaps an upcoming period will require more effort, time, and patience than expected.

There is an intriguing contrast here: you are resting on a sofa, yet the dream dictionary speaks of work. Could this be a moment to organize your tasks and save your energy for what matters most?

### Harm from a Woman

The second traditional meaning is possible harm caused by a woman. It gives the dream a more mysterious, cautionary tone.

If a relationship already feels strained or uncertain, paying attention to what is actually happening may be helpful. A dream alone is not a reason to suspect someone; real actions and honest conversations matter more.

### The Main Meaning of the Dream

In traditional dream interpretation, **lying on a sofa means hard work or harm from a woman**. One peaceful image, two very different possibilities: which part of life currently needs greater care — your responsibilities or your relationships?
